description: This Java source file defines the AuthenticationServerClient class, which facilitates communication with an external Authentication Service over AMQP 1.0 for token retrieval and user verification. It includes methods for verifying external subjects and verifying username/password credentials, utilizing Vert.x and Proton libraries for asynchronous network communication.

classes.name: AuthenticationServerClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with an external Authentication Service over AMQP 1.0, capable of verifying external subjects and username/password credentials asynchronously.

methods.name: AuthenticationServerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with Vert.x instance and connection factory.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Method intended to verify a subject DN using SASL External; currently always fails as mechanism is unsupported.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Method to verify username/password credentials using SASL PLAIN, establishing an AMQP connection and retrieving a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: mapConnectionFailureToServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Maps connection or authentication exceptions to custom service invocation exceptions.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Obtains a token from the Authentication Service by opening a receiver link, handling incoming messages, and processing the token asynchronously.

methods.name: openReceiver
methods.description: Opens a Proton receiver link over the given connection with a specified message handler.
